data_fields.name: shrineCharges
data_fields.donor_constant: 1 (altar tile goes inert after one raise)

data_fields.name: raisePickRule
data_fields.donor_constant: highest totalPowerCount, tie by higher monsterID

best_idea: Hold a dead companion in a pool instead of freeing it, and let a zone shrine raise the strongest held companion at full health, so a companion's death costs a wait, not the companion.
decision_why: Keep the held pool and the strongest-first raise at full heal; make shrine charges zone data and print a message when nothing is held; reject the donor's permadeath for the player, since Frankendom respawns at a point (row 17).
acceptance: A companion dies in a world-zone fight, leaves the field and is held for its owner; stepping on the shrine trigger raises the strongest held companion at full HP beside the shrine and spends one charge; with no charges the shrine refuses and says so; a summoned copy that dies is freed and never listed as held.
